questions.question: The ages of two friends, Ram and Ravi, differ by 7 years. Ram's mother Mayadevi is three times as old as Ram, and Ravi is four times as old as his brother Soham. The ages of Mayadevi and Soham differ by 65 years. Find the age of Mayadevi (in years).
questions.questionHtml: The ages of two friends, Ram and Ravi, differ by 7 years. Ram's mother Mayadevi is three times as old as Ram, and Ravi is four times as old as his brother Soham. The ages of Mayadevi and Soham differ by 65 years. Find the age of Mayadevi (in years).
questions.solution:
Let Ram's age be R. Then, Ravi's age is R + 7.

Mayadevi's age is 3R. Let Soham's age be S.

Ravi's age = 4S, so R + 7 = 4S.

⇒ R = A + 7 ----- (1)

M = 3 × R ----- (2)

A = 4 × S ----- (3)

M - S = 65 ----- (4)

Substituting value of M from equation (2) in equation (4),

⇒ 3 × R - S = 65

⇒ 3 × (A + 7) - S = 65 [From equation (1)]

⇒ 3 × A + 21 - S = 65

⇒ 3 × A - S = 44 ----- (5)

Substituting value of A from equation (3) in equation (5),

⇒ 3 × (4 × S) - S = 44

⇒ 12 × S - S = 44

⇒ 11 × S = 44

⇒ S = 4

Substituting value of S in equation (3),

⇒ A = 4 × 4 = 16

Substituting value of A in equation (1),

⇒ R = 16 + 7 = 23

Substituting value of R in equation (2),

⇒ M = 3 × 23 = 69

∴ Mayadevi's age is 69 years.

questions.question: Two circles of radii 18 cm and 12 cm touch each other externally. Find the length (in cm) of their direct common tangent.
questions.questionHtml: Two circles of radii 18 cm and 12 cm touch each other externally. Find the length (in cm) of their direct common tangent.
questions.solution:
Given: r1 = 18 cm, r2 = 12 cm

d = r1 + r2 = 18 + 12 = 30 cm

Length = √(d2 - (r1 - r2)2)

= √(302 - (18 - 12)2)

= √864 = 12√6 cm

questions.question: \(\frac{2+tan^22A+cot^22A}{sec\ 2A \ .\ cosec\ 2A}\) is equal to ___________.
questions.questionHtml: \(\frac{2+tan^22A+cot^22A}{sec\ 2A \ .\ cosec\ 2A}\) is equal to ___________.
questions.solution:
(2 + tan2 2A + cot2 2A) / (sec 2A × cosec 2A)

⇒ tan2 2A + cot2 2A = sec2 2A × cosec2 2A - 2

⇒ (2 + (sec2 2A × cosec2 2A - 2)) /(sec 2A × cosec 2A)

⇒ (sec2 2A × cosec2 2A) / (sec 2A × cosec 2A) ⇒ (sec 2A × cosec 2A)

questions.question: The value of 15 ÷ 3 of 2 × 2 + 9 ÷ 18 of 2 × 4 – 4 ÷ 8 × 2 is:
questions.questionHtml: The value of 15 ÷ 3 of 2 × 2 + 9 ÷ 18 of 2 × 4 – 4 ÷ 8 × 2 is:
questions.solution:
Given:

15 ÷ 3 of 2 × 2 + 9 ÷ 18 of 2 × 4 - 4 ÷ 8 × 2

15 ÷ (3 × 2) × 2 + 9 ÷ (18 × 2) × 4 - 4 ÷ 8 × 2

(15 ÷ 6) × 2 + (9 ÷ 36) × 4 - (4 ÷ 8) × 2

2.5 × 2 + 0.25 × 4 - 0.5 × 2 = 5

questions.question: The bar graph given below shows the sales of books from six schools during two consecutive years, 2013 and 2014. What percentage of the average sales of the schools A, B, and C in 2014 is the average sales of schools A, C, and F in 2013?
questions.questionHtml:
The bar graph given below shows the sales of books from six schools during two consecutive years, 2013 and 2014.

What percentage of the average sales of the schools A, B, and C in 2014 is the average sales of schools A, C, and F in 2013?
questions.solution:
The average sales of the schools A, B and C in 2014 = (70 + 35 + 80)/3 = 61.66

The average sales of schools A, C, and F in 2013 = 50 + 60 + 40)/3 = 50

Percentage of the average sales of the schools A, B, and C in 2014 is the average sales of schools A, C, and F in 2013 = (50/61.66)× 100 = 81.08%

questions.question: A money bag contains one rupee, 5 rupee and 10 rupee coins in the ratio of 3 : 5 : 7 respectively. If the total amount in the bag is ₹980, then find the number of coins of ₹10.
questions.questionHtml: A money bag contains one rupee, 5 rupee and 10 rupee coins in the ratio of 3 : 5 : 7 respectively. If the total amount in the bag is ₹980, then find the number of coins of ₹10.
questions.solution:
Let the number of one rupee coins be 3x, 5 rupee coins be 5x, and 10 rupee coins be 7x.

3x + 25x + 70x = 980

98x = 980

x = 10

Number of ₹10 coins = 7x = 7 × 10 = 70

questions.question: If a right circular cone of height 24 cm has a volume of 1232 cm 3 , then the total surface area of the cone is:
questions.questionHtml: If a right circular cone of height 24 cm has a volume of 1232 cm<sup>3</sup>, then the total surface area of the cone is:

options.html: 806 cm2
704 cm2
904 cm2
608 cm2

questions.solution:
h = 24 cm, Volume = 1232 cm3

1232 = (1/3) × (22/7) × r2 × 24

⇒ r = 7 cm

l = √(r2 + h2)

⇒ l = 25 cm

Total surface area = (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 25)

⇒ Total surface area = 704 cm2

questions.question: Let 0º < t < 90º. Then which of the followings is true?
questions.questionHtml: Let 0º < t < 90º. Then which of the followings is true?
questions.solution:
Given: 0º < t < 90º

sin(t) and cos(t) are positive

sin(45º) = cos(45º) = 1/√2

When 0º < t < 45º

sin(t) increases from 0 to 1/√2

cos(t) decreases from 1 to 1/√2

Thus

for 0º < t < 45º, sin(t) < cos(t).

questions.question: Ramesh purchased some items from a dealer on 19 November 2019. The bill generated was for ₹5,480. He had also purchased some items on 10 November 2019 having the bill value of ₹9,800. He cleared both the bills this time and paid the total amount in cash. If the dealer gives a scheme of 2% discount on the payments done within 10 days and 5% for the payments made in cash at the time of purchase, then find the amount paid by Ramesh on 19 November 2019.
questions.questionHtml: Ramesh purchased some items from a dealer on 19 November 2019. The bill generated was for ₹5,480. He had also purchased some items on 10 November 2019 having the bill value of ₹9,800. He cleared both the bills this time and paid the total amount in cash. If the dealer gives a scheme of 2% discount on the payments done within 10 days and 5% for the payments made in cash at the time of purchase, then find the amount paid by Ramesh on 19 November 2019.
questions.solution:
₹9,800 × 2/100 = ₹196

₹9,800 - ₹196 = ₹9,604

₹5,480 × 5/100 = ₹274

₹5,480 - ₹274 = ₹5,206

Total amount = ₹9,604 + ₹5,206 = ₹14,810

questions.question: Find the gain percentage, given that Priya sold her scooter for ₹42564 gaining \(\frac{1}{6}\) th of the selling price.
questions.questionHtml: Find the gain percentage, given that Priya sold her scooter for ₹42564 gaining \(\frac{1}{6}\)th of the selling price.
questions.solution:
Selling price = ₹42564

Gain = (1/6) × 42564 = 7094

Cost Price = 42564 - 7094 = 35470

Gain Percentage = (7094 / 35470) × 100 = 20%

questions.question: Study the given table and answer the question that follows. The given table shows the production of three types of cars (A, B and C) manufactured (in thousands) by an automobile company over the years. Year A B C 2015 840 680 890 2016 900 750 960 2017 760 620 1000 2018 800 540 1200 For all the years from 2015 to 2018, the average production of B-type cars is how much less (in thousands) than that of the combined average production of A-type and C-type cars
questions.questionHtml:
Study the given table and answer the question that follows.
The given table shows the production of three types of cars (A, B and C) manufactured (in thousands) by an automobile company over the years.
Year A B C
2015 840 680 890
2016 900 750 960
2017 760 620 1000
2018 800 540 1200


For all the years from 2015 to 2018, the average production of B-type cars is how much less (in thousands) than that of the combined average production of A-type and C-type cars
questions.solution:
The average production of B-type cars = (680 + 750 + 620 + 540)/4 = 647.5

The combined average production of A-type cars and C-types cars = (840 + 900 + 760 + 800)/4 + (890 + 960 + 1000 + 1200)/4 = 918.75

Difference = 918.75 - 647.5 = 271.25

questions.question: In a circular race of 750 m, X and Y start from the same point and at the same time with speeds of 9 km/h and 13.5 km/h, respectively. If they are running in the same direction then, when will they meet again for the first time on the track?
questions.questionHtml: In a circular race of 750 m, X and Y start from the same point and at the same time with speeds of 9 km/h and 13.5 km/h, respectively. If they are running in the same direction then, when will they meet again for the first time on the track?
questions.solution:
Speed of X = 9 km/h = 2.5 m/s

Speed of Y = 13.5 km/h = 3.75 m/s

Relative speed = 3.75 m/s - 2.5 m/s = 1.25 m/s

Time = 750 m / 1.25 m/s = 600 seconds

questions.question: A bus travels (1)/(3) of the distance initially at a speed of 40 km/h, the next (1)/(3) of the distance 50 km/h, and the final (1)/(3) of the distance at 60 km/h. Find the average speed of the bus for the entire journey. (Rounded off to two decimal places)
questions.questionHtml: A bus travels (1)/(3) of the distance initially at a speed of 40 km/h, the next (1)/(3) of the distance 50 km/h, and the final (1)/(3) of the distance at 60 km/h. Find the average speed of the bus for the entire journey. (Rounded off to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
Let total distance be d km, distance for each part = d/3

Time for 1st part = (d/3) / 40

Time for 2nd part = (d/3) / 50

Time for 3rd part = (d/3) / 60

Total Time = d/3 (1/40 + 1/50 + 1/60) = d/3 (0.025 + 0.02 +

0.01667) = d/3 (0.06167) = d × 0.02056

Average Speed = d / (d × 0.02056) = 1 / 0.02056 = 48.65 km/h

questions.question: Three pipes P, Q and R can fill a cistern in 40 minutes, 80 minutes and 120 minutes, respectively. Initially, all the pipes are opened. After how much time (in minutes) should the pipes Q and R be turned off so that the cistern will be completely filled in just half an hour?
questions.questionHtml: Three pipes P, Q and R can fill a cistern in 40 minutes, 80 minutes and 120 minutes, respectively. Initially, all the pipes are opened. After how much time (in minutes) should the pipes Q and R be turned off so that the cistern will be completely filled in just half an hour?
questions.solution:
Pipe P: 6 units/min, Pipe Q: 3 units/min

Pipe R: 2 units/min

P for 30 min: 6 × 30 = 180 units

Remaining: 240 - 180 = 60 units

Time for Q + R: 60 / (3 + 2) = 12 min

questions.question: If the sum of three numbers is 18 and the sum of their squares is 36, then find the difference between the sum of their cubes and three times of their product.
questions.questionHtml: If the sum of three numbers is 18 and the sum of their squares is 36, then find the difference between the sum of their cubes and three times of their product.
questions.solution:
a + b + c = 18

a2 + b2 + c2 = 36

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

182 = 36 + 2(ab + bc + ca)ab + bc + ca = 144

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ca) +

3abc

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = 18(36 - 144) + 3abc

= 18(-108) + 3abc

The difference is -1944
